caption: The drawing features a large stylized flower dominating the center of the composition. The flower consists of symmetrical, elongated petals rendered alternately in red, yellow, and blue, with the two outermost petals being blue, two inner petals being red, and the central section being yellow with a red interior. The base of the flower emerges from a blue and white striped vase with red handles on either side. Smaller, red and blue leaves and shapes extend upwards from the vase along the central stem. Surrounding the central flower are motifs arranged symmetrically: there are four circular designs with crosses made of blue, red, and yellow on each corner, and two large six-pointed stars composed of red, blue, and yellow elements, filled with blue dots, positioned at the lower left and right of the drawing. The background is a plain, yellowed paper, and the style is flat with bold colors and no shading. There is some typed and handwritten text at the bottom of the sheet.
title: Drawing for Plate 9: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
